facts.statement: Linhenykus is an extinct alvarezsaurid theropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Inner Mongolia, China.
facts.quote: Linhenykus is an extinct genus of alvarezsaurid theropod dinosaur from the Late Cretaceous of Inner Mongolia, China.

facts.statement: The femur of Linhenykus measures 7 cm in length.
Linhenykus is the first known alvarezsaurid to possess only a single, second digit on its forelimbs.
facts.quote: Linhenykus is the first known alvarezsaurid to have only a single, second digit.

facts.statement: The fossil of Linhenykus was collected by Jonah N. Choiniere and Michael Pittman from the Wulansuhai Formation in Inner Mongolia, China.
facts.quote: The fossil of Linhenykus was collected by Jonah N. Choiniere and Michael Pittman from the Late Cretaceous Wulansuhai Formation of Nei Mongol (Inner Mongolia), China.

facts.statement: Linhenykus lived during the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages, approximately 75 to 71 million years ago.
facts.quote: Biostratigraphic and lithographic correlations suggest that the formation dates to the Campanian and Maastrichtian stages, 75-71 Ma.

facts.statement: Linhenykus was first described and named in 2011 by Xu Xing, Corwin Sullivan, and seven other researchers.
facts.quote: The genus was first described and named in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences by Xu Xing, Corwin Sullivan, Pittman, Choiniere, David Hone, Paul Upchurch, Tan Qingwei, Xiao Dong, Lin Tan and Han Fenglu in 2011.

facts.statement: It has been debated whether Linhenykus is a junior synonym of Parvicursor, but this view was rejected by the original authors and subsequent researchers.
facts.quote: It has been suggested that Linhenykus may be a junior synonym of Parvicursor, but this interpretation was rejected by the original authors and has not been adopted in subsequent research on alvarezsauroids.

facts.statement: Linhenykus monodactylus is the only known species of the extinct genus Linhenykus, an alvarezsaurid theropod that lived during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous in Asia.
facts.quote: Linhenykus monodactylus es la única especie conocida del género extinto Linhenykus de dinosaurio terópodo alvarezsáurido que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente 80 millones de años, durante el Campaniense en lo que es hoy Asia.

facts.statement: Linhenykus was a small dinosaur with a length of approximately 70 cm.
facts.quote: Linhenykus era de pequeño tamaño, con una longitud de unos 70 cm.

facts.statement: While most alvarezsaurid species have reduced first and third digits, Linhenykus is the first known to have only a single digit on its hands.
facts.quote: Aunque antes se creía que tenían un solo dedo, se ha comprobado que la mayoría de las especies sí tenían los dedos primero y tercero, aunque muy reducidos. Linhenykus es el primero que tiene realmente un solo dedo en las manos.

facts.statement: The fossil of Linhenykus was found in the Upper Campanian Wulansuhai Formation, dating to 84 to 75 million years ago.
facts.quote: El fósil de Linhenykus fue hallado por Jonah Choiniere y Michael Pittman en la Formación Wulansuhai de Mongolia Interior en China, que data del Campaniense Superior, hace 84-75 millones de años.

facts.statement: Linhenykus is the most basal known member of the subfamily Parvicursorinae.
facts.quote: Es el miembro conocido más basal de la subfamilia Parvicursorinae.

facts.statement: The time range for Linhenykus is the Campanian stage, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group of Linhenykus is the subfamily Parvicursorinae.
Linhenykus belongs to the family Alvarezsauridae.
Linhenykus is classified within the class Reptilia.
